newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish June reserves rise to 110.0 bln DKK.
newsitem.headline: Danish June reserves rise to 110.0 bln DKK.

text.p: Denmark's foreign exchange reserves rose to 110.0 billion crowns at end-June 1997 from 108.8 billion crowns at end-May, according to the central bank's monthly balance sheet released on Wednesday.

NOTE - In a statement the Central Bank said it purchased a net 0.8 billion crowns in foreign currency and the state took up a net 0.4 billion crowns in foreign loans in June. Four analysts polled by Reuters had on average forecast Denmark's foreign reserves would rise to 109.2 billion crowns in June, excluding net foreign loan transactions.
